answer: Each identity grows one vine across the lagoon, and the k-th vine must cross k ripple rings, paying its heptagonal number of lagoon pearls: the first pays 1, the second 7, the third 18, the fourth 34, so ten identities pay 880 pearls. Every vine must root in its own lagoon bed, and each ring stays disturbed one tide per earlier vine, so the hundredth fake waits 99 tides.
